limitations: Seven CTest runs and three Python CI runs are separate jobs. Registered CTest counts and unittest summary counts include explicitly listed skips; skips are not represented as passes.
macOS ARM skips six core and nine VST3 x86 MXCSR FTZ/DAZ modes. All five quadrature-engine selectors pass in each core/sanitizer job.
The four module coexistence/duplicate-guard selectors are Linux-only; no macOS or Windows execution is inferred.
CI Python3.11 uses platform-specific versions and optional-backend/capability skips. The later local Python3.12/NumPy/SciPy run is separate evidence.
Decoded normalized text hashes bind retained bytes, not original server ZIP bytes, independent log authenticity or binary reproducibility.
Native success and sanitizer observations do not establish every host, compiler flag, concurrency schedule, allocator operation or audio-device deadline.
